reviews.reason: The selected source glyphs, both asterisks, cross-page continuation, restored answer verb, and terminal ፡፡ agree with the supplied printed pages. “Afraid and alarmed” appropriately renders the question; “sight of this suffering” is contextual and adequately qualified. Footnote a correctly connects p56 note4 with p55 note46: Charles restores the wrongly transposed word after ወድንጋጼከ, following Uriel’s question, without claiming independent manuscript attestation at that position. Greek remains comparison rather than replacement. Chapter completion remains blocked by 21:6.
